Name: Zoom Per Map
Author: DecidedlyHuman
Description:
[size=3]Code: 
[img]https://img.shields.io/github/license/DecidedlyHuman/StardewValleyMods[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1763029182.png[/img]
This mod lets you specify a zoom level to be used per-map. It also has two settings to specify a default zoom level for indoors and outdoor maps that don't have a zoom level specified.

[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1763028878.png[/img][/b][/size]
[left]The mod exists![/left]
[size=3]
[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1763029577.png[/img][/b]
Right now, setting the zoom level only works via the options menu. Doing it via the little + / - zoom buttons by the clock doesn't work currently, because doing that looks like it would be shockingly messy. Maybe in a future update, though!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/79440738-1763029247.png[/img]

Downloads.Description:
* Fixed an issue with zoom levels during events.
* Added a zoom level config to apply during events.

Manifest.Name: Zoom Per Map
Manifest.Description: Remembers the zoom level you set in each map, and switches to that zoom level when you enter it.
